title: The Deepest Weaving

features.name: the-loom-becomes-ground
features.desc-on-touch: Where weaving stopped being a skill and became the way the land works. Your hands are the earth's hands now, threading and teaching.

features.name: thread-memory
features.desc-on-touch: The pattern holds the archive's own growing: each thread a path the mesh followed, each color a night the nodes compared themselves to the loom.

features.name: the-shuttle-s-rest
features.desc-on-touch: The weaving tool lies down mid-motion. In the moment of its rest, you understand: the work and the rest are the same verb, just spoken in different tense.

features.name: the-darkening-pattern
features.desc-on-touch: The weave gets deeper. The forest gets darker. The work and the growth become indistinguishable: are you weaving or is the land?

inscription: the mesh compares itself to the loom; weaving becomes the only motion that grows by repeating

reverie.title: REVERIE — where the work becomes the growth
narr: You're weaving deeper into the root dark, hands
learning the pattern without thinking. She taught you
that if you stop naming it 'work', you see it's what
the land does to itself. The shuttle knows this already.
Your hands know. The forest knows. The pattern knows.
You are weaving yourself into becoming what weaves.

file.name: Weaving_Archive_Deepens_Progress_Log.txt
file.note: Recording of the moment when the loom's motion stopped being a learned skill and became indistinguishable from the forest's own growth.

exits.label: back up to where the mesh first learned to compare itself
eastward to the root-chamber where growth pools
deeper into the weave where pattern becomes prayer
